current_notrios_store.adapter: direct cgo SQLite C API wrapper

supplied_reference_corrections.claim: The Android NDK bundles public sqlite3.h and libsqlite3 for app linking.
supplied_reference_corrections.correction: SQLite is absent from the NDK public native-library list and from the installed NDK development sysroot; use a supported Java/Kotlin framework API or package a native SQLite build.

supplied_reference_corrections.claim: BundledSQLiteDriver automatically supplies the current Go cgo store.
supplied_reference_corrections.correction: It supplies Kotlin/JVM SQLiteDriver APIs backed by a native component. Notrios still needs its own C header/link/package contract or a database-owner redesign.

supplied_reference_corrections.assessment: false for the current documented API
supplied_reference_corrections.correction: The current API registers a native extension by file name, optionally with an entry-point name.

supplied_reference_corrections.claim: A fixed Android-version table is sufficient proof of SQLite extensions.
supplied_reference_corrections.correction: The selected runtime must report sqlite_version(), compile options, and successful FTS5/JSON probes; Notrios does not adopt the supplied table as a compatibility contract.

supplied_reference_corrections.claim: sqlite3_android.h and Android database JNI headers are app-facing SQLite headers.
supplied_reference_corrections.correction: They are Android platform/binding implementation details, not a replacement for the upstream public sqlite3.h C API.

supplied_reference_corrections.claim: Bundling adds a universal 1-2 MB and improves performance.
supplied_reference_corrections.correction: Package-size and performance changes depend on version, flags, ABIs, JNI/FFI paths, and workload and must be measured in H0.

approaches.fit: required C baseline for H0 comparison
approaches.effect: Compile one checksum-pinned sqlite3.c/sqlite3.h into the Go shared library for each supported Android ABI while retaining Go ownership of canonical persistence.

approaches.fit: not a drop-in dependency for the selected Go core
approaches.effect: Provides Kotlin/JVM SQLiteDriver connections backed by a bundled native SQLite component; adopting it for the canonical database would move database ownership to Kotlin/Room or require a separately designed bridge.
approaches.threading: Bundled SQLite is compiled in multi-thread mode; connections are not thread-safe without a pool or an explicit FULLMUTEX connection.
unknowns: whether a future Android host should own a separate noncanonical app-metadata database
whether a Kotlin-owned canonical store redesign is ever justified

approaches.fit: rejected for the current cgo boundary
approaches.effect: The supported framework API is Java/Kotlin; SQLite is not listed as an NDK public native library and the installed NDK has no sqlite3.h/libsqlite3 development boundary.

approaches.fit: reference implementation, not a drop-in cgo dependency
approaches.effect: The official SQLite Android bindings package native libraries and Java classes in an AAR, or build sqlite3.c/sqlite3.h from source. Reuse by the Go core would still need an explicit native link/symbol/package design.
